At noon he carried a lantern down the north stair, counted the swollen stones, and noticed that the seventh bore the same red wax mark.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘尚未靠岸的船。写字楼的灯一层层熄灭，只有便利店的白光守着空荡的街口。环卫车缓缓驶过，水花把霓虹推成模糊的长线；天桥下，早点铺掀开铁门，第一缕白汽升起来。远处的高架仍有零星车灯，像迟归的星。风穿过梧桐叶，带着夜雨微凉的气息。城市还未醒，却已有无数双手，悄悄替它整理黎明。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It needs a stopping point, called the base case, so it does not go on forever.\n- Imagine opening nested boxes: you open each smaller box until you find the prize, then come back out."}
